title: The Song of the First Stars
title_liraasa: Li lira de li una-ne veluri
about: The author's creation hymn, in the sacred register. Canon corpus text by the author's request (2026-10-25): a model of devotional Liraasa. Lines 1, 3, 4, 5, 9 and 19 are the 2.5 translation (data/songs/Liraasa_de_li_Vanisan_Lirayo_Translation.pdf, where the English, the interlinear and the translator's notes are); the other eighteen are the 3.0 patch's revisions (archive/patch_3_0/liraasa_3_0_patch.json, hymn_test), which use the proposed 3.0 words and rulings. Every line reads with no error or warning under the strict checker (tests/grammar/hymn.test.ts), in 3.1 and in 3.3. Nothing here is composed by a tool except line 12's one change, noted on the line, which the author kept (2026-10-25).

lines.liraasa: En li lombiasa, po miyo doli saivo de mavoasa,
lines.english: At the beginning of time, there was only her divine mind,

lines.liraasa: kroti saivo de finipidiri sarbisia li krono ala li pagoasa.
lines.english: Before her fingertips wrote time into existence,

lines.liraasa: Saivo po semnesia nuna-pago, intra saivo de yanoasa, ata po pensapa.
lines.english: She sat in nowhereness within the oneness of herself and pondered,

lines.liraasa: Saivo po pensapa ki-coda po miyo, ata ki-coda suvi miyo, ata ki-coda suvi miyo nuna-krono.
lines.english: She contemplated what was and what ought to be, and what ought never be,

lines.liraasa: Saivo po lemula li modoasa de li lumiasa, ata saivo de lumina gase li sadoasa.
lines.english: She studied the nature of her own divine light, and her absence as shadow

lines.liraasa: Ata saivo po lurvala saivo de velniasa ala li fulenasan pagona yuta li veraasa de li narvonasan sambalordi.
lines.english: And with her knowledge of flawless symmetry she imbued her essence into the empty non-universe,

lines.liraasa: Krotiata saivo de lumisan mavoasa po farlafa li pagoasa yuta baba patuti de lumi.
lines.english: Her luminous mind then brought forth existence with a point of light,

lines.liraasa: Li una-ne velu po navunia, ata ito sela po ka li una-ne leninela raho po lenila saivo de lumiasasan melopuku, saivo de meloasa, saivo de vallaasa.
lines.english: The first star arose and was itself the first to hear her divine cadence, her music, her voice

lines.liraasa: Ata li mareasa de li lumi po lirala ala li una-ne velu de li vemiasa.
lines.english: And the mother of light sang to the first star of the cosmos,

lines.liraasa: Li una-ne velu po veluva en tranaasasan lumisirmoasa, ata po ralera saivo de liraasa.
lines.english: The first star shone with transcendent resplendence and echoed her song of the first stars,

lines.liraasa: Li mareasa de li vemiasa, li una-ne lumi raho po kronobioka li veluri, po ke lavisan kube saivo lenila saivo de liraasa gase baba yanolira.
lines.english: The cosmic mother, the first light who birthed stars, was pleased to hear her song as a chorus,

lines.liraasa: Ata una krotiapo una, velu krotiapo velu, muya loterosan patuti de sizosan lumi po gome farlafa ala li pagoasa.
lines.english: One by one, star by star, further points of shimmering light were brought forth into existence,
lines.source: the 3.0 patch (hymn_test), with "kasi muya" (not ruled) as "muya loterosan", the 2.5 translation's word for "further"; the author kept this wording (2026-10-25)

lines.liraasa: Rada velu po kronobioka kopisa sahi lirala baba lirvi en saivo de lumiasasan melonulu.
lines.english: Each star was born to repeatedly sing a musical note in her divine melody,

lines.liraasa: Ata kroti ola, saivo po lirala; korsi, saivo po bitiba saivo de vinyeasa, baba lumiasasan melobiti.
lines.english: And where she sang before, instead she wielded her cosmic veena, a divine instrument,

lines.liraasa: Rada pice de li vinye po ke baba tranaasasan lumisirmo raho po lumrala li suma de li veluri raho lenila.
lines.english: Each pluck of her tool was a transcendent splendor which ascended the heat of the listening stars,
lines.source: the 3.0 patch (hymn_test); "heat" (suma) is as the author meant it, not "heart" (2026-10-25)

lines.liraasa: Saivo de rinbaasasan melolekta po ka li cemnuasa, kasa toda li pagoasa po kronobioka kopisa lenila saivo de meloasa.
lines.english: Her unending concert was the center of the universe, as all of existence was born to hear her play,

lines.liraasa: Saivo de nole po ka sambasan ko li melo, ito sela, en toda lermi raho po keleka.
lines.english: Her name was synonymous with music itself, in every language that arose,

lines.liraasa: Yesta li mavopagori raho po ne lavbula ala saivo, po sabesia fime saivo miyo, yuta verasado ata kronosonbu.
lines.english: Even the civilizations that did not pray to her knew of her existence by implication and rhythm,

lines.liraasa: Baba kasi lardasan vera nosi ka li vorduasa de li pagoasa ki?
lines.english: Could a more artistic truth be the underlying cause of existence?

lines.liraasa: En li mellisan vemiri, li lideoserbuyori raho tovota sonbuyebasan felberi, loki senoralkasia eli-krono.
lines.english: The philosophers of the great worlds with their attuned ears still debate, to this day,

lines.liraasa: Nara saivori senoralkasia nayo saivori pebudumdopa gase li lirviri raho saivo picepa su saivo de lumiasasan vinye.
lines.english: But they do so as they tap their feet in accordance with the notes plucked on her divine veena,

lines.liraasa: En li vemiri vofa maivori, yesta li mosa sirmosan deviserbuyori ata li luminelari ata li pensayori momvima saivori sela en li melo.
lines.english: Even the greatest theologians and priests and thinkers of the faraway worlds lose themselves to music,

lines.liraasa: Ata ola-modo po miyo, ola-modo miyo, ola-modo futu miyo.
lines.english: And so it was, and so it is, and so it shall be,

lines.liraasa: Liraasa, li lira de li una-ne veluri gagu li una-ne mareasa, vobi li una-ne linuri raho po lenila ata po lemula sidu senosia.
lines.english: Liraasa, the song of the first stars, by the first mother, for the first children, who listened and learned to speak
